entries.ed45c5c6f6c90743: This business handles prescription pharmaceuticals. The company entrusts the manufacture of pharmaceuticals to its subsidiary Mochida Seiyaku Kōjō Co., Ltd., and purchases and sells those products. It also purchases and sells products from its subsidiary Mochida Seiyaku Hanbai Co., Ltd. For some pharmaceuticals, Mochida Seiyaku Hanbai Co., Ltd. purchases from the company and from its equity-method affiliate Andpharma Co., Ltd. and sells them, and for some medical devices, its U.S. subsidiary Mochida Medical USA, Inc. purchases from the company and sells them. Mochida Seiyaku Kōjō Co., Ltd. entrusts part of the manufacture of pharmaceuticals to its subsidiary Technofine Co., Ltd. General affairs work is handled by its subsidiary Mochida Heartful Service Co., Ltd., and the company also outsources this work to it.
entries.faaaaa8ecf8e1bd3: This business handles healthcare products such as skincare products. A subsidiary, Mochida Healthcare Co., Ltd., entrusts the manufacture of healthcare products to a subsidiary, Mochida Seiyaku Kōjō Co., Ltd., and purchases and sells those products.
